description: Write or clear a program's status line: the one current sentence about where the program stands, shown under its delivery health on a report's program status board. Overwrites the previous line; the history is in the audit trail. Requires `write` scope and a key holder who can edit programs.

latestStatus.description: The line, or null (or an empty string) to clear it.

name: anyforge_set_program_status_line
title: Set program status line
